If you have any further questions about your balance in the app, you can learn more about your Google Pay balance. Still have questions? Head over to https://support.google.com/googlepay

To learn more about Google Payments, visit the Google Payments Help Center.

quotes.text:
I read your comment and checked the app page. (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.nbu.paisa.user) It had 4.5 stars. I was like what is this commenter talking about.

I then dig into the comments and there are a massive number of negative comments. I am not sure what is happening here but the rating seems artificially inflated. It shows that there are only 9 1-stars and yet in comments there are way more 1-stars. Really sad to see this sort of gaming at the play store level.

quotes.text:
I read Google's announcement about Flutter 2, and saw that Google Pay switched to it. Of course their developers loved it.

So I had a look at the app reviews for Google Pay: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.google.android.apps.nbu.paisa.user&showAllReviews=true

Everyone laments how the old version was better, the new one is prettied up, bloated, and slower as a result.
